run_dbscan: run DBSCAN clustering on a feature array using the dbscan function with eps and min_samples parameters
create_DBSCAN: create a DBSCAN clustering estimator with custom eps, min_samples, metric, and leaf_size parameters
test_DBSCAN_fit: test the DBSCAN fit method to cluster data and identify core samples and noise points
refactor_DBSCAN_fit_predict: refactor the DBSCAN fit_predict method to compute clusters and return labels in a single call
summarize_DBSCAN: summarize the DBSCAN class including its attributes labels_, core_sample_indices_, and components_
